title: Seam Bowling Good Length (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, seam bowling
Hold the seam upright, let the pitch do the work
The seam goes either way off the surface
You just have to land it right

[Verse 1]
Hold the ball with seam upright and straight
Two fingers on top, thumb below, wait
Release with the seam pointing at the target
Good length landing, let the seam work it

Good length is six to eight metres from the stumps
Batter cannot go forward or back, in the lumps
Too full and they drive, too short and they cut
Good length seam bowling, keeps the batter shut

[Pre-Chorus]
Seam upright, release it straight
Six to eight metres, good length rate
Let the surface move it off the line
Seam bowling good length, every time

[Chorus]
Seam bowling good length, upright seam
Six to eight metres, batters dream
Move off the surface either way
Seam bowling good length, all day

[Verse 2]
Out swing tilts the seam toward fine leg side
In swing tilts the seam toward slip, let it ride
Both use the same good length target zone
Seam direction changes, length stays home

[Bridge]
Bluey: That has seamed off the pitch and taken the edge, brilliant bowling
Trevor: The seam was perfectly upright at release, allowing maximum surface interaction
Chas: Son, I say, seam upright, land it six to eight metres out, let the ground do the talking

[Chorus]
Seam bowling good length, upright seam
Six to eight metres, batters dream
Move off the surface either way
Seam bowling good length, all day

[Outro]
Seam upright son
Six to eight metres
Let the pitch talk
Thats my boy
